meta.title: Warframe Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert FPS sensitivity to Warframe. Accurate mouse sensitivity calculation.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_warframe-sensitivity-converter_1De: Input your Warframe mouse sensitivity from Options → Controls → Mouse Sensitivity. Warframe's third-person fast movement differs from standard shooters.
steps_warframe-sensitivity-converter_2De: Choose the game to convert to. Warframe's parkour and ability-based gameplay mean aim feel translates differently to traditional shooters.
steps_warframe-sensitivity-converter_3De: Apply the converted sensitivity. Spend time in low-level missions adjusting to the new game's aiming mechanics and movement style.
